book.name: Matayu
book.title: Varu poia to Yesu Krisi to Matayu imbooda Matyu—Matthew

content: Sei to iza tiina kat
Sawa tonenen, taghoniiŋa to Yesu tila toni, ve tighasoni tighaze: “Yes to titaghon pooz to ndug sambam, sei to iza tiina kat?” Lu 22:24
Yesu ipoi pain kainaŋen eez inim, ipayoonda iyoon ila lolodi, ve isaav padi ighaze:
“You nasaav payam kat. Ighaze atoor ŋgar tiam inim ndipain geegeu ŋgar todi maau, yam pale irau ataghon pooz to Maaron ve alooŋ ala ndug sambam ne maau. Mt 19:14; Mk 10:15; Lu 18:17
Pasa, sei to ighaze itatan tau iza inimale pain kainaŋen tonene, nene ye iza tiina kat ilib pa tamtoghon tisob to titaghon pooz to ndug sambam.
Ighaze tamtoghon eta mata iŋgal ghou, ve igham pain kainaŋen eta tovene ve iuuli pa you izag, nene ye igham ghou paam.” Mt 10:40; Lu 10:16; Yo 13:20
Tagham nditaad titap pa ghurla todi malep

Yesu isaav muul ighaze: “Ndipain to tighur inim tiou ne, ighaze tamtoghon eta iwat todi eta, ve ighami itap pa ghurla toni, nene ye ikaria tau wa. Tamtoghon tovene, poia pa timbit yaam tiina ila lua, ve tipandalini izila mazovan bibiliiŋa lolo ve ilale.

Tamtoghon to taan to tinim watiiŋ pa nditadi, yes tikaria taudi wa. Onoon, tovaaŋ naol pale tivot, ve tipamundigin tamtoghon pa tigham ŋgar samsamia, ve tigham di titap pa ghurla todi. Eemoghon tamtoghon to ighaze inim watiiŋ pa ita ite, ve ighami itap pa ghurla toni, nene ye ikaria tau wa.

“Ighaze nimam ma aghem eta igheghereb ghom pa ghamuuŋ sosor, nene poia pa umbut motini ve upiyaava ilale. Onoon, yom pale unum narape. Eemoghon muri, yom pale ulooŋ ula ndug sambam, ve uneep matam iyaryaar. Ve ighaze nimam ru ve aghem ru tineep, nene pale unoknok ghamuuŋ sosor, ve sawa to Mboŋ Muri, ghoro tipiyaav ghom uzila yab to ighanghan irau sawa isob. Mt 5:29+

Ve matam tovene paam. Ighaze matam dige eta igheghereb ghom pa ghamuuŋ sosor, nene poia pa upeii ve upiyaava ilale. Onoon, yom pale matam atulu ee moghon. Eemoghon muri, yom pale ulooŋ ula ndug sambam, ve uneep matam iyaryaar. Ve ighaze matam rugharu tineep, nene pale unoknok ghamuuŋ sosor, ve sawa to Mboŋ Muri, ghoro tipiyaav ghom uzila ndug samia to yab ighanghan pani.”
Yesu isaav muul ighaze: “Matamim iŋgal pooi. Ndipain geegeu tovene, matamim velegin eta malep! Pasa, you nasaav payam kat: Yes aŋela todi tinepneep ila Tamaŋ Maaron nagho izi sambam irau sawa isob.”
Hib 1:14
Saveeŋ palelaaŋ to sipsip to ilale

Yesu isaav muul ighaze: “Laak, yam agham ŋgar vena? Ighaze ŋgeu eta, ye le sipsip tamoot liim (100), ve todi eta ipas ila lolodi, ve ila isagsag, nene pale igham vena? Ye pale ipul sipsip toni tamoot paaŋ saaŋgul liim ve paaŋ (99) tonenen tineep lolooz dige, ve ila ikaal ye to ilale.
Ve you nasaav payam. Ye pale ikalkaala le ighaze indeeŋa, nene pale lolo poia kat pa sipsip ee moghon tonenen, le ilib pa sipsip toni pida to tilaledi maau ne.
Ve Tamamim Maaron to ineep izi sambam, ŋgar toni raraate. Ye lolo pa pain tiou eta ilale malep.”
Ataam to gharatooŋ saveeŋ to toŋvetaz to Krisi

Yesu isaav muul tovene: “Ighaze toŋvetaz tiom eta igham sosor payom, ula toni, ve yamru moghon aneep, ve upaes pani pa sosor toni, leso ighilaala. Ighaze ye ilooŋ aliŋam, nene poia. Pasa, yom ugham mulin toŋvetaz tiom ve yamru alup gham muul. Ga 6:1; Yems 5:19+

Eemoghon ighaze ye ilooŋ ghom maau, ghoro ula ugham tamtoghon eta ma ruta, ve yamŋa ala atoov saveeŋ pani muul. Leso sa saveeŋ to ighaze ye isavia, yes tilooŋa paam. Ve ighaze muri, yam apaesia aliŋa pa tamtoghon pida, yes pale tighur ila saveeŋ tiam. Pasa, yam ndiran ru ma tol to apariaaŋ saveeŋ tonenen. Lo 19:15; Yo 8:17

Ve ighaze ye ilooŋ gham maau, ghoro apaesia saveeŋ toni ila lupuuŋ to Maaron lolo. Leso yes paam anadi tilooŋa ve titiir saveeŋ toni. Ve ighaze tamtoghon tonenen iyasiil pa lupuuŋ to Maaron paam, ghoro apuli, ve ineep inimale yes ndiran to youŋ takes ve yes to tiwatag Maaron maau. 1Tim 5:19+; Ro 16:17; 1Kor 5:13

“You nasaav payam kat: Ighaze yam aŋgalsek pa ŋgar eta izi taan, nene pale ŋgalsekiiŋ raraate tovene ivot izi sambam. Ve ighaze ayok pa ŋgar eta izi taan, nene pale yokiiŋ raraate tovene ivot izi sambam paam. Mt 16:19; Yo 20:23

“Ve you nasaav payam muul tovene: Ighaze tamtoghon tiam ruta ma tolta tilup lolodi, ve tighason Tamaŋ Maaron to ineep izi sambam we pa mbeb eta, ye pale ilooŋ suŋuuŋ todi, ve igham anoŋa ivot. Mk 11:24; Yo 15:7
Pasa ighaze tamtoghon ruta, ma tolta tilup di ila you izag, you pale naneep toman di.” Mt 28:20; Yo 14:23
Saveeŋ palelaaŋ to mbesooŋa to lolo isamin ita ite maau
Ghoro Petrus ila igharau Yesu ve ighasoni ighaze: “Tiina, ighaze toŋvetaz tiou eta inoknok ghamuuŋ sosor payou, pale napul sosor toni irau pa piiz? Pa liim ve ru, pale iraua?”
Yesu ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “Liim ve ru, nene iraua maau. Unini malep. Ighaze yom upul sosor toni irau pa tamoot tol saaŋgul liim ve ru (77), nene paam iraua maau.
Pasa, pooz to ndug sambam, nene inimale kinik eez. Ye ighaze iŋgabiiz yes mbesooŋa to tiŋgin yaam toni. Leso iwatag: Yes tiŋgin poian yaam toni, ma maau?
Ye ipamundigin uraat to gabizooŋ di, ve tigham mbesooŋa toni eez ila ivot toni. Ŋgeu tonowen, bun toni tiina le tiina kat. Tanini, pale taza pani maau.
Mbesooŋa tonenen, ye le yaam irau to iyat bun toni maau. Tovenen kinik isaav ariaŋa ighaze tigholia ŋgeu tonenen toman azuwa, ndinatu, ve mbeb toni tisob. Leso tigham yaama, ve tiyat bun toni pida.
Mbesooŋa tonenen ilooŋ saveeŋ to kinik, ve iput aghe izi nagho, ve itaŋ rorani ighaze: ‘Aa kinik tiou, utatan atem, ve ughur soso mala ris payou. Leso nayat bun tiou isob ilat tiom.’
Tovenen kinik lolo isamini, ve ipul bun toni toman sosor toni, ve ipuli ila.
“Mbesooŋa tonenen ivot ila pumuri, ve indeeŋ ita ite eez to mbesooŋa to kinik paam. Ita ite tonowen, ye igham bun tiina ris ila toni inimale denari
tamoot liim (100). Ye iza to ita ite tonenen, ve nima ila igigin lua, ve isaav pani ighaze: ‘Ai, yom irau uyat bun tiom rikia moghon!’
Tovenen ita ite tonenen iput aghe izi nagho, ve itaŋ rorani ighaze: ‘Aa ŋgeu tiou, utatan atem ve ughur soso mala ris payou. Leso nayat bun tiou ilat tiom.’
Eemoghon ye ilooŋa maau. Ŋgar toni iyaryaaŋ kat. Tovenen isaav ve tipiyaav ita ite tonenen ilooŋ ila ruum to yabyabuuŋ lolo. Leso ineep tonowe le irau iyat suvun bun toni.
“Eemoghon mbesooŋa pida to kinik tighita ŋgar to ye ighami, le irau lolodi maau. Igham di lolodi ipataŋan kat. Tovenen tila to tiina todi, ve tipaes pani.
Kinik ilooŋ saveeŋ todi, ve rikia moghon ipoi ŋgeu tonowen inim, ve isaav pani ighaze: ‘Yom tonene, mbesooŋa samia kat! Yom utaŋ roran ghou, tauto lolog isamin ghom, ve napul bun tiom isob.
Ŋgar to nagham payom, yom paam irau utaghon ŋgar raraate moghon, ve lolom isamin itam ite. Pughu vena to ugham tovene maau?’ Ep 4:32; Kol 3:13
Tovenen kinik ate yabyab kat, ve ana ighur mbesooŋa tonenen ila uraata toni pida nimadi, leso tighur yabyabuuŋ tiina pani, le irau iyat suvun bun toni.” Mt 5:25+

Ghoro Yesu ipasob saveeŋ toni tovene: “Ighaze toŋvetaz tiam eta igham sosor payam, yam lolomim isamini, ve apul sosor toni le apuli kat. Ighaze agham tovene maau, nene pale Tamaŋ Maaron to ineep izi sambam igham ŋgar raraate moghon payam inimale kinik tonowen igham pa mbesooŋa toni.” Mt 6:15; Mk 11:25; Yems 2:13

footnotes.text: -11 Ndiran ŋgara pida tighaze saveeŋ pida ineep ila saveeŋ waaro tonene paam. Saveeŋ tovene: “Tamtoghon Natu, ye inim pa ikaal yes to tisosor pa Maaron ataam toni, ve igham mulin di.”
Saveeŋ to Matayu imbooda, ighazooŋ kat maau. Ndiran ŋgara pida tighaze ye imbood tovene: “Ve ighaze yom upul sosor toni irau pa 490 (70 taims 7), nene paam iraua maau.”

Matayu imbood saveeŋ tovene: Bun to mbesooŋa tonene, nene irau ‘talent’ 10,000. Talent, nene yaam todi eez iza. Talent 10,000, nene yaam tiina kat, irau Kina milion milion. Tovenen mbesooŋa tonene bun toni, tiina le tiina kat.
Sawa to Yesu ineep izi taan, ighaze tamtoghon eta igham uraat irau ndag eez, nene tigham le atia irau denari eez. Tovenen bun to mbesooŋa tonene ighami, nene tiina ris, eemoghon tiina kat maau.
